reviewNotes: Twelve source-paired release-description candidates for four existing languages, not native AGY provenance or fluent certification. Source links were reviewed via official primary-page text. No feed body/schema/local alert status/reuse clearance, provider downtime or crop-advice update is established. No new runtime language.

releasePairs.english: Open INMET’s weather-alert website, portal or RSS link. Source links were reviewed; the feed, local alert status and reuse terms have not been verified. These links do not update crop advice.
releasePairs.zu: Vula iwebhusayithi yezixwayiso zezulu ye-INMET, ingosi noma isixhumanisi se-RSS. Izixhumanisi zemithombo zihlanganisiwe zahlolwa; okuphakelayo, isimo sezixwayiso sendawo nemigomo yokusetshenziswa kabusha akukaqinisekiswa. Lezi zixhumanisi azishintshi izeluleko zezitshalo.
releasePairs.st: Bula webosaete ya ditemoso tsa boemo ba lehodimo ya INMET, portal kapa sehokelo sa RSS. Dihokelo tsa mehlodi di hlahlobilwe; feed, boemo ba ditemoso tsa lehae le dipehelo tsa tshebediso hape ha di eso netefatswe. Dihokelo tsena ha di fetole keletso ya dijalo.
releasePairs.ve: Vulani webusaithi ya tsevho dza mutsho ya INMET, portal kana vhuṱumani ha RSS. Vhuṱumani ha zwiko ho sedzuluswa; feed, vhuimo ha tsevho dza henefho na milayo ya u shumisa hafhu a zwi athu khwaṱhisedzwa. Vhuṱumani uhu a vhu shanduli ngeletshedzo dza zwimela.
releasePairs.ts: Pfula webusayiti ya switsundzuxo swa maxelo ya INMET, portal kumbe xihlanganisi xa RSS. Swihlanganisi swa swihlovo swi kamberiwile; feed, xiyimo xa switsundzuxo swa ndhawu ni swipimelo swa ku tlhela u tirhisa a swi si tiyisisiwa. Swihlanganisi leswi a swi cinci switsundzuxo swa swibyariwa.
